title: nf-demux-preg samplesheet schema
description: Minimal per-library input contract. One row per independently processed sample.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must be provided and contain no spaces; it must be unique.

bam.errorMessage: bam must be a path to a .bam file with cell barcodes.

barcodes.errorMessage: barcodes must be a (optionally gzipped) filtered cell-barcode file.

expression.errorMessage: expression must be a CellRanger filtered_feature_bc_matrix directory (v1 primary format).
